title: Computer Case
oneLine: A PC chassis I drew in CAD and machined myself.

hero.alt: Open frame computer chassis holding a motherboard, graphics card and closed loop cooler, lit against a dark background

intake.question: What is it, in one sentence?
intake.hint: What you built and why the off-the-shelf option did not work.
intake.draft: Custom machined chassis with CAD design and CNC fabrication.

intake.question: What did you decide, and what did you reject?
intake.hint: Material and process choice, and what you rejected.

intake.question: What number can you put on it?
intake.hint: Volume in liters, temps under load before and after, weight, cost, dB.

intake.question: What broke, and what did you do?
intake.hint: What broke or did not fit.

intake.question: What media do you have?
intake.hint: CAD, in progress, finished, and a thermal comparison chart if you measured.

intake.question: What would you do differently?
intake.hint: Two sentences. Not self criticism, a design judgement you would make differently now.
